title: Verify that an unauthenticated user cannot access Dynamic Widgets Management via direct URL
description: Forced-browsing check on the CMS admin screen managing the widgets.

steps.action: Log out of the Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Session ends, user is logged out

steps.action: Navigate directly to the Dynamic Widgets Management URL
steps.expected: User is redirected to the Liferay login page; Dynamic Widgets Management content is not displayed

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can access and configure Dynamic Widgets Management
description: Positive role-access check for the primary permitted role.

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as Site Content Editor
Navigate to Home Page → Dynamic Widgets Management
steps.expected: Dynamic Widgets Management screen loads showing Weather, Marhaba Guide, and B2B Platform widget entries, editable

title: Verify that a role without Home Page content permission is denied access to Dynamic Widgets Management
description: Verifies RBAC enforcement for a role lacking the required permission.

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as a role with no Home Page management permission
Attempt to navigate to Dynamic Widgets Management
steps.expected: Access is denied with a permission-denied message; widget configuration is not displayed or editable

title: Verify that an expired session during widget editing discards unsaved changes and prompts re-login
description: Session-timeout handling mid-edit of a widget configuration.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor, open Marhaba Guide widget for editing
steps.expected: Widget edit form is open with unsaved changes

steps.action: Let the session expire (or force-expire it)

steps.expected: Save fails; user is prompted to re-authenticate; the unsaved edit is not persisted

title: Verify that a Public Visitor session cannot reach Dynamic Widgets Management even with a valid frontend session cookie
description: Confirms the public-facing session context is not sufficient to reach the admin management screen.

steps.action: Browse the public Home Page as an unauthenticated visitor
steps.expected: Home Page loads normally for the visitor

steps.action: Attempt to navigate directly to the Dynamic Widgets Management URL
steps.expected: Navigation is blocked/redirected to the CMS login; management screen is never rendered

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can fully configure and publish the Marhaba Guide widget end-to-end
description: Full admin journey: image (EN/AR), URL, new-tab toggle, order, active status, save, publish, and visibility on the Home Page after cache refresh.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor, open Marhaba Guide widget
Upload Widget Image (EN) marhaba_en.jpg and Widget Image (AR) marhaba_ar.png
steps.expected: Both images upload successfully and preview

steps.action: Enter Redirect URL https://marhabaguide.qa/qatar-chamber, enable Open in New Tab, set Display Order = 1, set Active Status = True
Refresh cache and load the Home Page
steps.expected: Marhaba Guide card appears on the Home Page reflecting the configured image and links correctly

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can fully configure and publish the B2B Platform widget end-to-end
description: Same full admin journey as TC-046, applied to the B2B Platform widget.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor, open B2B Platform widget
Upload Widget Image (EN) b2b_en.jpg and Widget Image (AR) b2b_ar.svg
steps.expected: Both images upload successfully and preview

steps.action: Enter Redirect URL https://b2b.qatarchamber.com/platform, enable Open in New Tab, set Display Order = 2, set Active Status = True
Refresh cache and load the Home Page
steps.expected: B2B Platform card appears on the Home Page reflecting the configured image and links correctly

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can configure the Weather widget's limited CMS settings end-to-end
description: Weather is API-driven; CMS management is limited to Active Status and Display Order.

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor, open Weather widget
steps.expected: Widget edit form opens showing only Active Status and Display Order fields (no image/URL fields)

steps.action: Set Display Order = 1 and Active Status = True
Refresh cache and load the Home Page
steps.expected: Weather widget appears first on the Home Page with live API data

title: Verify that unpublishing a previously published widget removes it from the Home Page
description: Marhaba Guide widget is currently Active and Published, visible on the Home Page.

steps.action: In CMS, unpublish the Marhaba Guide widget
Refresh cache and load the Home Page
steps.expected: Marhaba Guide card no longer appears on the Home Page; the other two widgets remain unaffected

title: Verify that editing a published widget's Redirect URL updates the live link on the Home Page after republish
description: B2B Platform widget is live with URL https://b2b.qatarchamber.com/platform; admin updates it to https://b2b.qatarchamber.com/platform-v2.

steps.action: In CMS, edit the B2B Platform widget's Redirect URL to https://b2b.qatarchamber.com/platform-v2 and save
Load the Home Page and click the B2B Platform widget
steps.expected: New tab opens navigating to https://b2b.qatarchamber.com/platform-v2, not the old URL

title: Verify that switching a widget's Active Status from True to False removes only that widget from the Home Page
description: All three widgets currently Active. Toggle only the Marhaba Guide widget off.

steps.action: In CMS, set Marhaba Guide Active Status = False and save
Refresh cache and load the Home Page
steps.expected: Marhaba Guide card no longer renders; Weather and B2B Platform cards remain visible and unaffected

title: Verify that a valid Widget Image (EN) uploads successfully for the Marhaba Guide widget
description: Uploads marhaba_en.jpg, 450KB, JPG format.

steps.expected: Image previews in the Widget Image (EN) field

title: Verify that saving the Marhaba Guide widget without a Widget Image (EN) is blocked
description: Widget Image (EN) left empty; all other fields valid.

steps.action: Leave Widget Image (EN) empty; fill all other fields

steps.expected: Save is blocked; 'Widget Image is required.' (EN) / 'صورة الأداة مطلوبة.' (AR) is displayed

title: Verify that a valid Widget Image (AR) uploads successfully for the Marhaba Guide widget
description: Uploads marhaba_ar.png, 450KB, PNG format.

steps.expected: Image previews in the Widget Image (AR) field

title: Verify that saving the Marhaba Guide widget without a Widget Image (AR) is blocked
description: Widget Image (AR) left empty; all other fields valid.

steps.action: Leave Widget Image (AR) empty; fill all other fields

steps.expected: Save is blocked; 'صورة الأداة مطلوبة.' / 'Widget Image is required.' is displayed

title: Verify that saving is blocked when only Widget Image (EN) is uploaded and Widget Image (AR) is missing
description: Field-dependency case: EN image uploaded, AR image left empty.

steps.action: Upload only Widget Image (EN) = marhaba_en.jpg; leave Widget Image (AR) empty
steps.expected: EN image previews; AR field remains empty
Save is blocked with the AR-specific 'صورة الأداة مطلوبة.' message; the EN image entry is not lost from the form

title: Verify that a valid Redirect URL saves successfully for the Marhaba Guide widget
description: Enters https://marhabaguide.qa/qatar-chamber (35 characters).

title: Verify that leaving the Redirect URL empty blocks saving the Marhaba Guide widget
description: Redirect URL left blank; other fields valid.

steps.expected: Save is blocked; 'Please enter a valid URL.' / 'يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.' is displayed

title: Verify that an invalid Redirect URL format is rejected
description: Enters marhaba guide site (no protocol, contains spaces).

steps.action: Enter Redirect URL marhaba guide site

steps.expected: Save is blocked; 'Please enter a valid URL.' is displayed

title: Verify that setting Active Status = True and publishing renders the Marhaba Guide widget on the Home Page
description: All mandatory fields valid; Active Status set True.

steps.action: Configure Marhaba Guide widget with all mandatory fields, Active Status = True

steps.expected: Marhaba Guide card renders on the Home Page

title: Verify that setting Active Status = False prevents the Marhaba Guide widget from rendering
description: All mandatory fields valid; Active Status set False.

steps.action: Configure Marhaba Guide widget with all mandatory fields, Active Status = False

steps.expected: Marhaba Guide card does not render on the Home Page

title: Verify that Active Status = True does not bypass the mandatory Widget Image (EN) validation
description: Field-dependency case: Active Status toggled on, but Widget Image (EN) left missing.

steps.action: Set Active Status = True; leave Widget Image (EN) empty
steps.expected: Active Status set True; EN image field empty
Save/publish is blocked by the mandatory image validation despite Active Status being enabled

steps.expected: Weather card renders on the Home Page

Save/publish succeeds without requiring an image or URL
Weather card does not render on the Home Page

title: Verify that a concurrent invalid edit does not overwrite a widget's currently live, valid configuration
description: B2B Platform widget is live with a valid Redirect URL; a second admin session attempts to save an invalid URL concurrently.

steps.action: Confirm B2B Platform widget is live with a valid Redirect URL
In a second admin session, open the same widget and enter an invalid Redirect URL
steps.expected: Invalid value entered in the second session

steps.action: Attempt to save from the second session
steps.expected: Save from the second session is blocked by URL validation; the original valid URL remains live and unaffected on the Home Page

title: Verify that clearing the Redirect URL on a live, published widget blocks the save and keeps the previous URL live
description: B2B Platform widget is Active and Published with a valid Redirect URL; admin clears the field and attempts to save.

steps.action: Open the live B2B Platform widget configuration
steps.expected: Form opens showing the current live URL

steps.action: Clear the Redirect URL field to empty

steps.expected: Save is blocked by the mandatory URL validation

steps.action: Load the Home Page and click the B2B Platform widget
steps.expected: The previously published valid URL still opens correctly on the Home Page — nothing broke live
